Having sat on
both sides of the table.

We have prepared companies for scrutiny, and we have been the party applying it. The same small number of things holds true on both occasions. None of them is complicated, and none is ever dealt with as early as it could have been.

The monthly pack says more than the forecast

A month's reporting describes the two years ahead more accurately than the forecast filed beside it, and at a fraction of the effort.

The work before an acceleration does not vary

Before any period of growth, the same work comes first: agreeing which figures matter, then reporting them the same way each month until they can be relied upon.

The quiet quarters matter most

Value accrues in the seasons when no one is watching. What held in the second quarter is what makes the fourth defensible.

Complexity outgrows its instruments

A company seldom loses control of its business. It loses sight of it, which arrives at the same place by a longer and more expensive road.

“The firm is built on the conviction that judgment is not delegable”
C.H. Tange Chief Executive

Every mandate is led, executed and concluded by the principal who accepted it.
